author: fable-cursor
criterion: Giant trunks read like the massive old trees framing the house in the reference.
note: The left giant at B is a moss-washed dark column with faint vertical fissures; no buttress flare at its foot, no large limbs at frame scale; the giants beyond are smooth cylinders in the haze (the new mist veil helps W32, not this). The reference's framing trunks are gnarled, flared and limbed. Unchanged in structure from take-0116.

history.author: fable-cursor
history.criterion: Giant trunks read like the massive old trees framing the house in the reference.
history.note: The giants do not read as massive old trees at B. The trunk right of the door is a smooth orange-brown wall with a painted burl: measured sigma 14.2 against the reference's 30.4 at the same region, i.e. less than half the surface variation, with no fissures at frame scale and no knotted buttress columns framing the opening. No buttress flare enters the terrain anywhere in the frame; the trunks meet a grass bank or a pebble field (take-0116-W09b-B-house-trunk-base.jpg). At D the left-edge giant is a flat dark green cylinder, #545a44 l 0.096 sigma 8.3, against the reference's pale hazed #7a7a70 l 0.193 (take-0116-W09c-D-left-giant.jpg). Auto gates are met (12 giants, giantRoots true, giantLimbsMin 2).

history.author: fable-cursor
history.criterion: Giant trunks read like the massive old trees framing the house in the reference.
history.note: The giants framing B are a smooth vertical cylinder with a green moss wash at the left edge (x 0.0-0.10, y 0.0-0.65) and the house trunk, a smooth orange-brown wall with a painted burl; C's two centre giants are straight hazed cylinders; D's left-edge giant is a flat green camo cylinder. No buttress flare enters the terrain in any frame, no bark fissures read at frame scale, and the near-horizontal limbs are smooth pale tubes. The reference's giants are knotted, deeply fissured, with roots spreading into the ground and heavy mossy limbs. 12 giants / roots / limbs pass the gate; the read does not.
